name: react-native-attachment
description: File and image attachments for React Native — media, metadata, upload states and actions.

scripts.build:js: bun build ./src/index.ts --outfile ./dist/index.js --format esm --target node --external react --external react-native && bun build ./src/index.ts --outfile ./dist/index.cjs --format cjs --target node --external react --external react-native
scripts.build: bun run clean && bun run build:js && bun run build:types
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run typecheck && bun test && bun run build
